title: GrowWithHR Child and Adolescent Labour Wave 5I Governed Safeguarding Source Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Child and Adolescent Labour official source-identity snapshot
sourcePack.notes: Wave 5I records current central Act, principal Rules, 2017 Amendment Rules, 2016 commencement and 2017 hazardous Schedule source identities. Exact controlled full-file Drive mirrors are not present in the active Source Register. State-specific instruments remain outside the first bounded pack.

limitations: The catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not an age-band, work/employment, hazardous-classification, exception, offence, rescue, enforcement, rehabilitation or remedy determination.
The 1988 principal Rules are source context and must be reconciled with the 2017 Amendment Rules and later controlled instruments rather than treated as a standalone current consolidated legal text.

Only privacy-safe organisation-level source, classification-source, exception-source, State-variation and human safeguarding/authority-escalation controls plus controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.

sources.title: The Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 — current consolidated text
Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Rules, 1988 — principal Rules
Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Amendment Rules, 2017 — G.S.R. 543(E)
Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2016 commencement — S.O. 2823(E)
Child and Adolescent Labour hazardous Schedule amendment — S.O. 2827(E)

chunks.title: Child prohibition source boundary
chunks.text: The current Act defines the central child-and-adolescent labour framework and prohibits engagement of children subject to statutory exceptions. Wave 5I records source and safeguarding controls only; it does not determine a person's age band, whether work or employment exists, whether an exception applies, or whether an offence occurred.

chunks.title: Adolescent hazardous-work source boundary
chunks.text: The Act prohibits engagement of adolescents in hazardous occupations and processes identified through the statutory Schedule and provides a mechanism to amend that Schedule. Wave 5I can record whether a current hazardous-work source route is controlled but cannot classify customer work as hazardous or decide whether Part A or Part B applies.

chunks.title: Family-enterprise exception safeguarding boundary
chunks.text: The 2017 Amendment Rules add safeguards around family-enterprise assistance, including hazardous-work exclusions and limits connected with schooling and time. Wave 5I treats these as exception-source and safeguarding controls only and never decides that a family-enterprise exception is available.

chunks.title: Child artist exception safeguarding boundary
chunks.text: The 2017 Amendment Rules prescribe safeguards and District Magistrate permission controls for child participation as an artist in permitted audio-visual entertainment activity. Wave 5I records only whether the organisation has controlled the source and escalation route; it does not approve participation, assess a child, or process permit-case details.

chunks.title: 2016 amendment commencement source
chunks.text: S.O. 2823(E) appoints 1 September 2016 as the date on which the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2016 comes into force. Wave 5I uses this as effective-date source context and does not infer the current status of any State instrument from it.

chunks.title: Principal Rules and 2017 amendment reconciliation
chunks.sectionReference: 1988 principal Rules read with G.S.R. 543(E), 2 June 2017
chunks.text: India Code lists the 1988 principal Rules and the 2017 Amendment Rules. Wave 5I requires a current-source reconciliation control so the principal Rules are not treated as a standalone current consolidated text and later amendments are not silently ignored.

chunks.title: Hazardous Schedule source boundary
chunks.text: S.O. 2827(E) amends the statutory Schedule used for hazardous occupation and process routing. Wave 5I treats the Schedule as a controlled classification source only; retrieval cannot map an organisation's activity to a Schedule entry or decide whether an adolescent may perform particular work.

chunks.title: Age-dispute, register and notice source controls
chunks.text: The Act contains age-dispute, register and notice provisions. Wave 5I may record organisation-level source readiness for those provisions but does not collect a child's date of birth or exact age, resolve an age dispute, certify register or notice compliance, or infer an offence.

chunks.title: District authority and safeguarding escalation source route
chunks.text: The amended framework assigns implementation, inspection and safeguarding functions to District Magistrates, inspectors and related district mechanisms. Wave 5I records only whether a human safeguarding and authority-escalation route is controlled; it must not transmit complaint, rescue, abuse, trafficking, victim, witness or case details to retrieval or the provider.

chunks.title: State variation and specialist-only boundary
chunks.text: The central Act and Rules do not by themselves establish the complete source set for every State or Union Territory. Wave 5I therefore records State-variation readiness and specialist escalation, while any State-specific source, enforcement, rescue, prosecution, rehabilitation or remedy conclusion remains outside the automated review.
